# local-leaf

> local-leaf is a free, open-source (MIT) offline alternative to Overleaf for macOS. It is a browser-based LaTeX editor that runs on your own Mac and compiles with your local TeX distribution (MacTeX, latexmk), with a live PDF and two-way SyncTeX. Projects are plain folders on disk, so git, the terminal, and AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex can edit them while the editor updates live. A `leaf` CLI lets agents open, compile, and read errors from the running editor.

Key facts:

- Platform: macOS with a TeX distribution providing `latexmk` and `synctex` (MacTeX puts them in /Library/TeX/texbin), and Node.js 18 or newer. Runs from source: `npm install && npm start`, then http://localhost:3737 (bound to 127.0.0.1 only).
- Editor: CodeMirror 6 with LaTeX highlighting, spellcheck, find/replace, completions for commands, environments, \ref labels and \cite keys, and Overleaf's keyboard shortcuts.
- Compile: latexmk with pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX; auto-compile on file change; parsed errors and warnings with file:line.
- Overleaf import: from a .zip (any plan) or over Overleaf's git integration (paid plans).
- Git: per-project commit, push, pull, and publish to GitHub from a sidebar panel.
- Terminal: integrated xterm.js terminal in the project folder with a one-click Claude Code launcher.
- Agent loop: edit files under `leaf root` → `leaf compile` (blocks, exit 1 on failure) → `leaf problems --errors` → repeat. Every command accepts `--json`.
- Differences from Overleaf: files stay local, no compile time limit, works offline, free Git; no real-time collaboration.

- [README](https://github.com/aneesh-iyer29/local-leaf/blob/main/README.md): features, install, Overleaf import, Git, terminal, CLI, shortcuts, comparison with Overleaf, FAQ
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aneesh-iyer29/local-leaf/main/AGENTS.md): how a coding agent should drive the `leaf` CLI to edit and compile a LaTeX project
- [CLI source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aneesh-iyer29/local-leaf/main/bin/leaf.js): every `leaf` command
- [Demo video](https://aneesh-iyer29.github.io/local-leaf/demo.mp4): 22 seconds, a real edit compiled by latexmk and the same build from `leaf compile`
